scope: offline incremental information event study; no strategy or trading

period_utc.reason_end: last complete published monthly archive; avoid partial October

oi_causality.reason: REST openInterestHist timestamp is documented as period end, but publisher does not document archive metrics.create_time mapping, measurement interval, or point-in-time availability; no safe causal conversion can be proven

causality.decision_time: UTC interval boundary T after all constituent 5m candles close; each raw closeTime <= T-1ms
causality.funding_availability: fundingTime < T strictly; do not use future next funding rate
causality.target_start: Spot close at T-1ms; future bar high/low/close only after T; no executable entry claim
causality.publisher_archive_lag_caveat: historical archive does not itself prove zero live publication latency

flow: persistence=share of prior 3 complete interval imbalance signs matching current sign
funding: latest strictly past realized funding rate
mean of last 3 strictly past rates
absolute rate percentile against strictly past 90 days, min 30 records
price_spot: current high-low divided by prior close
price_futures: same five price/volume controls from aggregated futures 5m bars without taker fields
features.zero_volume: NULL flow imbalance and exclude feature-dependent row; never divide by zero
features.missing: No forward fill across missing bars; funding latest valid for at most 24h, else NULL; drop same rows across A/A2/B/C model comparisons; report dropped counts

targets: signed Spot close-to-close forward return in percent
absolute Spot forward return in percent
directional forward MFE and MAE from future Spot high/low in percent

controls.A2: Spot plus futures OHLCV excluding taker fields; main incremental control
controls.C: A2 plus flow and funding on identical complete rows
controls.model: per-symbol, per-timeframe Ridge(alpha=10) with discovery-only standardization; intercept; same rows; no hyperparameter search
controls.primary_model_metric: validation MSE reduction (A2-C)/A2 for signed return; positive means incremental information

splits.contamination: prior project research examined 2024-2025 OHLCV and 2026 4h; these are chronological internal checks, not pristine external holdout
splits.purge: exclude any row whose primary or secondary target extends beyond segment end

hypotheses.H1: Flow continuation: abs(current imbalance)>=discovery q75, aligned with current futures price move; directional forward return residual above A2-predicted directional return >0
hypotheses.H2: Flow exhaustion: abs(current imbalance)>=discovery q90 and abs(current futures return)>=discovery q75, signs aligned; directional forward return residual below 0
hypotheses.H3: Price x OI: NOT TESTED because OI causality unconfirmed
hypotheses.H4: Funding crowding: abs(latest known funding)>=discovery q90; forward absolute return residual above A2-predicted absolute return >0
hypotheses.H5: Flow + OI: NOT TESTED because OI causality unconfirmed

thresholds: Per symbol and timeframe broad quantiles from discovery features only; q75/q90 fixed before validation. No threshold search.

inference.cluster: UTC ISO calendar week, all symbols in same resample block
inference.familywise: Holm adjustment across six primary one-sided tests

pass.ROBUST: validation effect correct sign; Holm-adjusted one-sided p<0.05; 2026 4h diagnostic same sign; >=6/8 symbols correct sign; all leave-one-symbol-out correct sign; C improves A2 MSE by >=0.001; effect >=0.3pp and remains >0 after 0.6pp hurdle; no leakage
pass.PROMISING: validation effect correct sign and C improves A2 MSE, but at least one ROBUST condition missing
pass.WEAK: validation effect correct sign but no clear incremental C>A2 or too few events
pass.REJECT: validation effect wrong sign or zero, or integrity fails

storage: immutable raw ZIP/JSON and manifest, normalized CSV.gz per symbol/timeframe because pyarrow unavailable; separate research directory
